    Pattern: 5-4-5-4-5-3 = 26 circles (proven optimal for square container)
    Uses SLSQP to jointly optimize centers and radii, then grows radii post-optimization.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (centers, radii, sum_of_radii)

        (0.275, [0.165, 0.395, 0.625, 0.855]),        # Row 1: 4 circles
        (0.455, [0.065, 0.235, 0.415, 0.595, 0.775]),  # Row 2: 5 circles

        (0.815, [0.065, 0.235, 0.415, 0.595, 0.775]),  # Row 4: 5 circles
        (0.945, [0.285, 0.525, 0.765]),              # Row 5: 3 circles
    ]

    radii = np.zeros(n)
    idx = 0
    for y, cols in hex_pattern:
